p: heavens declare the glory of God: He reproaches man for his ingratitude, seeing the heavens, which are dumb creatures, set forth God's glory.
Day unto day uttereth speech: The continual success of the day and night is sufficient to declare God's power and goodness.
language: The heavens are a schoolmaster to all nations, no matter how barbarous.
line is gone out through all: The heavens are as a line of great capital letters to show God's glory to us.
chamber: Or vail. The custom was that the bride and bridegroom would stand under a vail together, and after come forward with great solemnity and rejoicing of the assembly.
law of the LORD is perfect: Though the creatures cannot serve, yet this should be sufficient to lead us to him.
true and righteous: So that all man's inventions and intentions are lies.
desired are they than gold: Unless God's word is esteemed above all worldly things, it is contemned.
reward: For God accepts our endeavour though it is far from perfect.
errors: Then there is no reward of duty, but of grace: for where sin is, there death is the reward.
presumptuous sins: Which are done purposely and from malice.
then shall I be upright: If you suppress my wicked affections by your Holy Spirit.
meditation of my heart: That I may obey you in thought, word and deed.
